name: Countdown
summary: A draining bar with the m:ss clock beside it, synced to the host's absolute end time so every phone reaches zero together. For a full-canvas audience slide only.
highlights: Synced to an absolute end instant; freezes when stopped
Points variant: min and max at the ends, no clock
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-countdown> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Track
spec.value: 8px pill, --aha-deck-stroke (ink at 12%) over the frosted blur, 1px ink hairline

spec.label: Fill
spec.value: deck accent; drains left as one linear CSS animation, never a per-frame redraw; a late joiner starts part-way

spec.label: Clock
spec.value: 14px semibold tabular m:ss, ticks once a second from the wall clock

spec.label: Points variant
spec.value: variant="points": no clock; min at the left end and max at the right in 14px semibold tabular deck ink, formatted by label-format; the bar starts full (max) and drains left toward min off the same ends-at / total-ms sync, or sits at progress (0-100) and eases between values on the shared motion tokens

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: ends-at
props.desc: The host's absolute end instant, shared by every phone

props.name: total-ms
props.desc: How long the question was given: the bar's denominator

props.name: stopped
props.desc: The host closed submissions early: bar and clock freeze where they are

props.name: clock-only / hide-clock
props.desc: Drop the bar (a tight header) or drop the digits

props.name: urgent-below-ms
props.desc: Below this, bar and digits take the DS error colour

props.name: label
props.desc: The accessible name (translated); read as "label: m:ss". Points variant: default "Points available", read with the points left as the progress bar's value

props.name: variant
props.desc: "points" swaps the clock for min and max end labels: the score bar of a self-paced quiz (points still available for a fast answer). Absent = the timer, unchanged. clock-only and hide-clock do not apply

props.name: min
props.desc: Points variant: the value at an empty bar, printed at the left end

props.name: max
props.desc: Points variant: the value at a full bar, printed at the right end

props.name: label-format
props.desc: Points variant: how min, max and the announced value are written; {n} is the number ("{n}p" → "500p"). Translate it with the slide's locale

props.name: progress
props.desc: Points variant: pins the bar at this share of full instead of draining off ends-at / total-ms (the host drives it). Read the points left from the element's value property (an integer, min to max)

whenToUse.when: a FULL-CANVAS audience slide that needs its own visible timer
a self-paced quiz where a faster answer scores more: the bar shows the points still available, min to max, with no seconds count
a framed slide: the host already paints the countdown above the iframe; use the host time limit as logic only

opinion.note: Never write a static time ("30 seconds") anywhere in the copy. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-countdown[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var t=cs(q('.track'));var k=cs(q('.clock'));return{trackHeight:t.height,fill:cs(q('.fill')).backgroundColor,clockSize:k.fontSize,clockInk:k.color,clockWeight:k.fontWeight};})()
